notes: Easier to use: Home now asks what you want to do (drive, run a program, write your own, make a map, change the robot's menu, copy a folder), the menu on the left is grouped in plain words, Programs and Code link to each other, the arguments box shows each program's own example, and Studio warns when a moving program is started on the dock. Windows: install TurtleBotStudio-Setup-2.2.0.exe from TurtleBot/Download.
